promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.subtitle: Illustrative offers for this demonstration build. None of them can be claimed, and none is a financial promotion.
promotions.demoNotice: This offer is illustrative. It cannot be claimed, no bonus funds exist, and no wagering requirement is enforced anywhere in this build.
promo.welcome-offer.title: Welcome offer
promo.welcome-offer.summary: A first-deposit match for new accounts, shown here as an example of how an offer would be presented.
promo.welcome-offer.description: New players would receive a matched amount on their first deposit, released as the qualifying stake is settled. In this demonstration nothing is credited and no deposit is possible.
promo.welcome-offer.terms.1: One offer per person, household and device
promo.welcome-offer.terms.2: Qualifying bets must be settled before release
promo.welcome-offer.terms.4: Not available in this demonstration build
promo.ligue1-boost.title: Ligue 1 price boost
promo.ligue1-boost.summary: An enhanced price on a selected Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 fixture each round.
promo.ligue1-boost.description: One fixture per round would carry an enhanced price on the match-result market. The boosted price is shown on the match card so it is never a surprise at settlement.
promo.weekend-multi.title: Weekend multiple
promo.weekend-multi.summary: An illustration of how a multiple-bet bonus would be presented on qualifying weekend fixtures.
promo.weekend-multi.description: Multiples of four or more legs on weekend fixtures would attract a percentage bonus on returns, scaling with the number of legs. Nothing is credited in this build.
promo.live-cashback.title: Live betting cashback
promo.live-cashback.summary: How a partial stake return on losing in-play singles would be presented.
promo.live-cashback.description: A losing in-play single would return part of its stake as a free bet. Presented here purely to show the card layout — no cashback exists in this build.
promo.live-cashback.terms.2: Free bet expires after seven days
promo.loyalty-club.title: Loyalty club
promo.loyalty-club.summary: A tiered programme concept, shown as a scheduled promotion so the 'coming soon' state is visible.
promo.loyalty-club.description: Tiers would be earned through activity rather than spend, with benefits that do not encourage higher stakes. This is a design placeholder, not an offer.
promo.caf-special.title: CAF competitions special
promo.caf-special.summary: An expired seasonal promotion, kept to show how ended offers are presented.
promo.caf-special.description: This offer has ended. Expired promotions stay visible and clearly labelled rather than disappearing, so a player can check what applied to a past bet.
